courseTitle: NativeScript + Angular: Build Native iOS, Android & Web Apps

cues.en: So in this module, we spend almost our entire time in angler code, and this is one of the great strengths
of native script with Angular, of course, we can use the knowledge we already have from Angler for
Web and take it into our native app, because all the logic we added was mostly around that one service.
I had a challenge service and the challenge model as well as the day model.
And there we added all the logic to generate a new challenge with generated days to manage it into service
and admitted to the different places in our UI that needed to create it, updated it and most importantly,
And we made sure that we can reuse our challenge actions and use the result of the action there.
So on the user action there.
So basically which button was click there in two different components, the current challenge component
and today component, where we then in turn have to code to update our challenge fruitage service.
And that is how you structure such an app and how you leverage the strengths of Angler to update what
you need to update and to communicate across your components.
And that is effective state management here in this app, which starts to look nice and which also now
starts to have some nice features and some nice logic in it and will build up on this in the next module
where we add HTP authentication and so on.
